Parse Hive DDL without recovery

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "tree_sitter_language_pack"
result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE t(`a` string, `b` array<string>)\nPARTITIONED BY (`p` string)\nROW FORMAT SERDE 'org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.parquet.serde.ParquetHiveSerDe'\nSTORED AS INPUTFORMAT 'x' OUTPUTFORMAT 'y'\nLOCATION 's3://{{bucket}}/t/'\nTBLPROPERTIES ('k'='v');", { 'language' => 'sql' })
puts result.language.inspect
puts result.metrics.error_count.inspect
puts result.metrics.total_bytes.inspect
puts result.structure.inspect
puts result.structure[0].name.inspect
```
